'''Imhar Canyon''' was a location on [[Ossus]]. According to the [[Qel-Droma Epics]], it housed a [[Jedi temple]] run by the [[Jedi Master]] [[Anstak]], situated in a submerged tunnel system, where Anstak trained [[Padawan]]s from amphibious species. Supposedly, after Ossus was devastated by the [[Cron Supernova]], some believed that Anstak and his students could have survived within the deep caverns.<ref name="NOP" />
